name: Bloodmage: Blood Covenant pays its health cost and places its ritual object (#3996)
contract: #3996: 'not taking health, no rune, can't summon.' Blood Covenant 1200012 is a channeled ritual built like Ritual of Summoning 698: effect 0 SPELL_EFFECT_TRANS_DOOR (50) at TARGET_DEST_CASTER_FRONT summons gameobject 194111, a GAMEOBJECT_TYPE_SUMMONING_RITUAL whose completion spell 1200014 places the meeting-stone rune 194114. Its cost is PowerType -2 (health) with ManaCostPercentage 90; per Bloodmage ADR 0003 (owner ruling O-9), 1200012 opts into UsesMaxHealthForCost so SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost takes 90% of max health: for a level-40 Human Bloodmage (704 base health + 390 from 57 Stamina = 1094 max health), int32(CalculatePct(1094, 90)) = 984, paid by Spell::TakePower when the channel starts. Neither 194111 nor 194114 had a gameobject_template row on base, so Spell::EffectTransmitted logged the missing template and returned. Expected: the cast costs 984 health and places gameobject 194111 in front of the Bloodmage.

steps.label: Let login and level scaling settle
Blood Covenant takes 90% of max health (1094 -> 984)
DISCRIMINATING: the Blood Covenant object stands in front of the Bloodmage
